grammar.change_scope: aligned the operator declaration with language-ref.md: operator-body is map-shaped so the declaration takes statement-end and body-closure-guard was removed (DECISION-OPDECL-005); fixity, associativity and arity values are qualified co.operator.* constants (DECISION-OPDECL-006)

structural_checks.decision_sync_policy: Executable grammar decisions must occur in both the EBNF and register. The external source-filename shape is represented by the source-filename secondary root. Filename-to-UpperCamelCase conversion, package indexing/merging, companion ownership, matcher signature equivalence, implicit type-variable quantification, configuration, bootstrap order, artifact projection, placement, conflict, conformance-profile, reserved-future-kind, and withdrawn historical decisions may be reference/register-only when they do not change a source-text production.

design_assertions.description: Local functions require a block definition and cannot be forward declarations.
Anonymous function, lambda, anonymous class and block forms are expressions.
Anonymous class expressions carry no declaration name.
forall is reachable through type-expression.
Ordinary function-declaration is not a direct package primary.
The grammar records declaration-site lexical scope for ordinary local functions.
The grammar records @co.dap.inner call-site lexical-context resolution.
Object construction is an expression and does not use body-close.
Pattern block bodies and expression results keep separate termination.
Direct anonymous function bindings use body termination.
Named UDT bodies use body-close.
Built-in directives are self-delimiting.
Enum variants are comma-separated.
Identifier production enforces the ASCII-leading ordinary identifier shape.
Numeric literal productions do not admit apostrophe/underscore digit separators.
Boolean and none literals use co.const spellings.
Dependent indices use the dedicated index production; dependentType is a direct type kind, and a type-level function has exactly one type-producing result (possibly one union).

design_assertions.description: Planned grammar constructs remain represented.
Built-in, pre-declared, and custom operator implementations all use mode=overload in legal function owners; distinct normalized signatures are permitted.
fol-conf.yaml configures operator_library_folder and the folder is excluded from package discovery.
operators.fol has exactly one @co.dap.library(type=operator) _ co.lang.library block containing only operator declarations.
Operator declaration attributes are typed; four parse attributes are required semantically and optional metadata keys are bounded to one occurrence.

design_assertions.description: Pre-declared mathematical/modifier glyphs are language-owned registrations and may receive overload implementations.
The operator source grammar is rooted at operator-source-file and is not reachable from compilation-unit.
co.lang.operator is absent from ordinary general-declarable-kind and appears only in the dedicated operator-source grammar.
Ordinary library artifacts and imports carry no operator table.
The alpha profile implements infix, prefix, and postfix custom operators; other fixities are reserved.
A contiguous symbol run is preserved whole, contextually classified, and never fallback-split into shorter operators.

evidence.symbolic-token:
? the complete maximal contiguous run of one or more symbol
                   characters after comments, literals, and closed composite
                   spellings are recognized; the run is preserved whole for
                   contextual classification and is never split as a
                   fallback ?

design_assertions.description: Multi-symbol expression operators enforce operand-facing boundaries while structural and metadata spellings remain contextually exempt.

evidence.infix_guard:
? zero-width condition: a multi-symbol infix operator has an explicit
      boundary on both operand-facing sides; a boundary is whitespace, a
      comment, or an applicable delimiter, checked before separators are
      discarded ?
evidence.range_guard:
? zero-width condition: a multi-symbol range operator has an explicit
      boundary on every side for which an operand is present ?

design_assertions.description: ++ and -- are absent from built-in prefix/postfix productions and are handled, when unregistered, by the general whole-symbol-run rule.
Pointer degree metadata accepts one whole contiguous star run, preserving the distinction between metadata spelling and expression-operator use.

evidence.pointer-stars:
? one contiguous symbolic run consisting only of one or
                  more "*" characters; its length is the pointer degree ?

design_assertions.description: Package source roots distinguish filename-backed primaries, ordinary units, companion units, and package metadata after external filename classification.
Filename-backed and special unit/library/package declarations use the filename-derived underscore slot.
The external source-filename grammar permits only ASCII identifier-shaped components and structural recognized suffixes.
Filename-backed public declaration names and companion owners use canonical UpperCamelCase display spelling while duplicate identity remains normalized and case-folded.

evidence.semantic_check: split explicit underscore boundaries; preserve mixed-case lower-to-upper boundaries; normalize single-case words; capitalize words; concatenate; compare identity using normalized case-folded stems

design_assertions.description: Ordinary/companion unit bodies admit functions, non-UDT type declarations, data declarations, type-level functions, and annotated function forms.
package.fol parses the exact underscore package declaration with one required string name field.
Entry files admit parameterized co.lang.type constructors while keeping type-level functions outside entry-item.

evidence.entry-parameterized-type-declaration:
annotations, identifier,
                                       generic-parameter-clause,
                                       "co.lang.type",
                                       [ kind-options ],
                                       [ "=", type-expression ],
                                       statement-end

design_assertions.description: Typeclasses use a separate filename-derived name and arity-capable parameter clause.
Matchers require type metadata and use a dedicated body; exact-one matchCase and signature equality are semantic checks recorded by DECISION-MATCH-001.
Direct generic parameter clauses occur only on parameterized type/data declarations, signature type components, entry type constructors, and typeclass parameters.
Reserved future co.lang.typeconstructor and co.lang.typefunction have no ordinary source production.
Companion ownership and operator first-operand requirements are recorded as semantic checks without restricting ordinary receiverless unit syntax.
No production references realm or parent-realm import fields or the co.lang.realm kind.
operator-declaration ends with statement-end and the fixity/associativity/arity values are qualified co.operator.* constants, matching language-ref.md.

notes: The language reference is authoritative; this revision also records the user-confirmed filename lexical and canonical-display rule that was previously only partial in the reference.
source-filename is an external metadata root evaluated before source-text grammar selection; filename bytes are not concatenated with source content.
Identifier-derived source filename components are ASCII-only, begin with a letter, and permit only letters, digits, and isolated internal underscores.
Recognized suffixes such as .fol, .unit.fol, and .comp.unit.fol are structural and are excluded from filename-component validation.
Filename-backed public declaration names and companion owners use canonical UpperCamelCase display spelling; normalized case-folded stems remain the duplicate-detection identity key.
Underscores provide explicit word boundaries when a multiword filename is written wholly in one case; absent boundaries cannot be reconstructed from an all-uppercase or all-lowercase run.
Entry files admit parameterized co.lang.type constructors but not ordinary or type-level function declarations.
Typeclass parameter clauses are separate from the filename-derived `_` and may express higher-kinded arity.
Matchers retain one declared subject type and one non-overloaded matchCase; resolved type/signature equality is a semantic validation.
Companion ownership comes from the filename; only operator receiverless/type-receiver functions add the owner-typed first-parameter requirement.
Reserved future kinds may remain in the language registry without receiving a grammar production or becoming currently usable.
Not every symbolic spelling is an operator; grammar context distinguishes structural tokens, contextual metadata, and expression operators.
A maximal contiguous symbol run is preserved whole and never fallback-split into shorter operators.
Operator registration and implementation remain separate and no operator metadata crosses ordinary library boundaries.
